_comment: Recorded model outputs for the DETERMINISTIC classification eval (Runner 2A). These stand in for the live model at the adapter boundary so the harness, budget/union/fail-closed logic, persistence and Verify Step can be exercised without an API key or network. They are NOT ground truth (labels.json is) and are NOT the live model's real output (Runner 2B). Chosen to exercise every branch: 05 = model MISSES the emergency (keyword-net union must still escalate); 11 = malformed output (budget exhausts retries -> fail-closed unknown/needs_review). Extracted field values are verbatim substrings of the fixture body so the hallucination check stays at 0.
